rationale: Single Alza press release confirming the Adyen acquiring switch — decisive evidence artifact, not a recurring feed.
Merchant payment-options help pages are diffable over time and reveal PSP/gateway switches before any announcement.
One Mesec article on Cvak A2A at Lidl/Albert; high-value evidence, but the parent outlet is the monitorable source.
Mesec.cz is a standalone CZ payments/consumer-finance daily and a strong snowball hub for PSP and bank signals.
Single outage article on penize.cz with siblings on domain; monitor the Penize.cz parent instead.
dTest advice board continually produces consumer failure-mode signals on banks, cards and gateways.
Per-merchant complaint database with gateway-failure detail; access mechanics and reuse terms unconfirmed.
CNB consumer-protection portal publishes regulator-grade complaint and supervisory statistics on payment institutions.
Static gov.cz signpost mapping complaint bodies — mine once to enumerate channels, no ongoing signal.
APEK studies are the canonical CZ checkout payment-mix time series; URL check failed, re-verify liveness.
DPP open-loop contactless fare pages track a flagship transit acceptance estate and its rollout phases.
PID news portal announces ticketing/payment milestones across operators and points to card issuers and clearing actors.
CD site documents onboard card acceptance with CSOB — a rare named merchant-acquirer relationship in transport.
Official MD CR bulletin archives carrier tariffs specifying accepted payment methods and refund mechanics.
Lidl help centre is first-party confirmation of in-store/self-checkout acceptance changes across a 320+ store estate.
Plugin-vendor changelog is a high-frequency machine-readable leading indicator of CZ gateway feature rollout.
WordPress.org gives install-count adoption proxies plus a merchant complaint forum for CZ gateway plugins.
Vendor-published Alza case study — one dated artifact corroborating the acquiring switch, not a producing feed.
Rohlik engineering blog occasionally discloses payment processors and checkout architecture; low but recurring yield.
Sub-page of globalpayments.cz; monitor the acquirer's site as parent rather than this Shoptet plugin page.
Low-credibility aggregator of consumer bank/payment incident coverage; largely redundant with Mesec and Penize.
JERRS is the canonical register of every licensed CZ bank, PI, EMI and notified TPP — the definitive actor universe.
CNB lists hub enumerates all regulator registers; mine once to snowball to the individual monitored registers.
Machine-readable CSV exports of CNB registers with ICO keys — lowest-friction live CZ actor list.
Official register API, but authentication requires a commercial certificate a human must procure.
Defines the CZ PI/EMI/PPSMR licence taxonomy needed to bucket register entries; reference read, rarely changes.
Licensing-pipeline page gives forward signal on new payment-market entrants and required vendor disclosures.
CNB enforcement decisions name institutions and expose systems, outsourcing and AML tooling found nowhere else.
